purpose: Profile the official MITECO IEET static database taxonomic groups across the frozen 77 Rioja grid cells and determine whether it can support an independent vascular-flora fallback corpus.
notes: No JBLR/RC2/Rioja curated corpus may be used. This run determines scope directly from official MITECO fields Grupo/Reino/Division/Clase and CUTM10x10 before any fallback corpus extraction.
